title: Result of channel.put
description: Request args: {"slot": n, "name": 1 to 31 bytes, "secret": 32 hex digits (a 128-bit key, as the native CMD_SET_CHANNEL frame)}. A key that another slot already holds is failed with error duplicate-secret; an all-zero key is invalid. The secret is written, never read back. Companion only.

hash.description: The channel hash on air: the first byte of SHA-256 of the key.

replaced.description: True when the slot held a channel before.
